Building overview

More modern-day social club than apartment community, 25 North Lex has been designed to create an experience you'll love, every single day. You'll see it in the big things, like our stunning architecture and you'll notice it in all the small details, like the upgraded features in our luxury apartments for rent in White Plains, NY.

Building amenities

Apartment features

  • Elegant, bright homes with neutral palettes ideal for personalization
  • Floor-to-ceiling windows
  • Upgraded kitchens with vertical pantries and separate oven and cooktop
  • Lighted mirrors and vanities with drawers
  • Dramatic light fixtures
  • Sophisticated white quartz countertops and backsplashes
  • French door refrigerators
  • In-unit washer and dryer
  • Paneled dishwashers

Community amenities

  • Lush 5th floor roof deck and 17th floor sky deck
  • Expansive infinity-edge pool with wet bar
  • Sports lounge with entertaining kitchen, fireplace and video wall
  • Game room with foosball, billiards, wet bar and golf simulator
  • Children's playspace
  • Fitness and yoga studios, both with outdoor space
  • Indoor/outdoor private dining room with full kitchen and lounge seating
  • Co-working areas with large tables and intimate nooks, private phone booths, and individual conference rooms
  • Dog run and pet spa
